description: This file implements a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) usage costs by agent name. It includes functions to determine the correct MongoDB collection, build aggregation pipelines for both flat and nested schema structures, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. The main exported function, getLlmCostByAgent, tries to perform server-side aggregation and falls back to in-memory processing if needed.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines collection names based on environment variable and default options, supporting comma-separated values and deduplication.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process flat schema documents, normalizing agent names and costs, and summing costs case-insensitively.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Generates an aggregation pipeline to process documents where agents are stored within an Agents array, normalizing and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Pure JavaScript fallback function that aggregates agent costs from an in-memory array of document objects with Agents array.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main async function that attempts server-side aggregation via MongoDB pipelines, falling back to in-memory aggregation if needed, returning a list of agents with total costs.
